Some of our cleaning experts will cover the bedrooms, living rooms, and common spaces, while specifically trained cleaners will focus on the bathrooms and kitchen.

The cleaners will cover all windows, frames, ledges, and sills internally as part of the cleaning service and will even focus on small details such as light sockets, light switches, and plugs.

The entirety of your property will be fully and professionally cleaned, this is why we are certain that you will receive an exceptional End of Tenancy Cleaning if you schedule our cleaning services. props.text: Why a Professional End of Tenancy Clean Matters

The most common reason tenants lose part or all of their deposit is cleanliness. Landlords and letting agents in Manchester are legally entitled to deduct from your security deposit if the property is not returned in the condition matching its original state.

Unlike a standard domestic clean, a professional move-out clean follows a structured, room-by-room protocol aligned with lettings industry standards. Our tenancy cleaners in Manchester are trained specifically for this type of work — handling everything from limescale-encrusted bathrooms to grease-coated oven interiors.

Booking a professional end of rental clean also saves you significant time during an already stressful moving period. Instead of spending your final days scrubbing appliances, you can focus on your move while our team handles the property to the standard your landlord expects.

props.text: Frequently Asked Questions: End of Tenancy Cleaning Manchester

items.q: Does your end of tenancy cleaning guarantee my deposit back?
items.a: While we cannot control the landlord's legal decisions, our service is specifically designed to pass the most rigorous inventory checks. We provide a 48-hour satisfaction guarantee and a professional invoice that acts as evidence for the Tenancy Deposit Scheme (TDS). If your inventory clerk identifies any cleaning issues, we return free of charge to rectify them.

items.q: Is professional oven cleaning included in the price?
items.a: Yes. Unlike many Manchester cleaning companies that charge extra, a full professional oven clean is included as standard in our end of tenancy package. We degrease the interior, clean the racks, and polish the glass to ensure it meets the "showroom" standard required by agencies like Jordan Fishwick and Philip James.

items.q: Do I need to be at the property during the clean?
items.a: No. We are experts in remote logistics. We can coordinate key collection and return from your estate agent's office or a concierge desk in developments like Deansgate Square or MediaCityUK. This allows you to focus on your move while we handle the heavy lifting.

items.q: How long does a professional move-out clean take?
items.a: The duration depends on the size and condition of the property. A studio in the Northern Quarter might take 3-4 hours, while a 4-bedroom family home in Didsbury or Altrincham could take 6-8 hours. We send teams of 2 or 3 cleaners to ensure the job is completed efficiently in a single day.

items.q: Are your cleaners employees or contractors?
items.a: Every cleaner at Cleaniq Services is a direct employee. We do not use unvetted gig-economy contractors. Our staff are fully background-checked, insured, and trained in our specific "Inventory-Standard" checklist to ensure consistent quality across all Manchester postcodes.

items.q: Do you provide your own cleaning supplies and equipment?
items.a: Yes. Our mobile teams arrive in fully equipped vehicles carrying industrial-grade supplies. This includes HEPA-filtered vacuums, professional steam cleaners for "wet zones," and a full range of eco-friendly, non-toxic detergents. You do not need to provide a single item.

items.q: Do you clean the windows and frames?
items.a: We clean all windows internally as part of the standard EOT service, including the frames, ledges, and sills. If you require external window cleaning or reach-and-wash services for high-rise apartments, this can be added as an optional extra.

items.q: Do you cover areas outside of the Manchester City Centre?
items.a: Yes. We cover a 600-square-mile radius across the North West. Our daily routes include Salford, Stockport, Bolton, Oldham, Wigan, Warrington, and Altrincham. If you have a postcode starting with M, SK, WA, WN, or OL, we have a team ready to assist.

items.q: What happens if the landlord isn't happy with the clean?
items.a: This is where our 48-hour guarantee comes in. If the landlord or agent provides an inventory report showing a cleaning failure, simply send it to us. We will dispatch a team to the property to perform a free re-clean of the disputed areas immediately.

items.q: Is carpet cleaning included in the end of tenancy service?
items.a: We hoover all carpets as part of the standard clean. However, for properties with deep stains or pet odors, we recommend adding our Professional Carpet Steam Cleaning (Hot Water Extraction). You receive a discount when you bundle this with your move-out clean.

items.q: Can you perform an EOT clean if the power or water is turned off?
items.a: No. For our teams to achieve an "Inventory Standard" finish, we require access to running water and electricity. Please ensure your utilities remain active until the cleaning service is completed.
